intro: A lean, stable base that nearly every modern Skyrim SE/AE load order builds on. Install in this order; most later mods assume these are present.

mods.name: Skyrim Script Extender (SKSE64)
mods.summary: Lets plugins hook the game executable; required by most of this list.
mods.note: Must match your exact game build. Install via the mod manager, then always launch through skse64_loader.exe.

mods.name: Address Library for SKSE Plugins
mods.summary: Version-independent lookup table so SKSE plugins survive minor game updates.

mods.name: SSE Engine Fixes
mods.summary: Patches dozens of engine bugs and crash sources; part 2 (preloader DLLs) goes in the game folder manually.

mods.name: Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch (USSEP)
mods.summary: Community fix-pack for thousands of quest, item and dialogue bugs. Keep it near the top of the plugin list.

mods.name: powerofthree's Tweaks
mods.summary: Small engine fixes and quality-of-life toggles that many other plugins expect.

mods.name: SSE Display Tweaks
mods.summary: Unlocks frame rate, fixes high-FPS physics and adds borderless/window options.

mods.name: SkyUI
mods.summary: PC-friendly inventory, favorites and magic menus plus the Mod Configuration Menu (MCM).

mods.name: MCM Helper
mods.summary: Framework that lets mods build their settings menus reliably inside SkyUI's MCM.

mods.name: Better Dialogue Controls
mods.summary: Stops the mouse and keyboard from picking the wrong line in conversations.

mods.name: Better MessageBox Controls
mods.summary: Keyboard and gamepad navigation for pop-up message boxes.

mods.name: RaceMenu
mods.summary: Expanded character creator with sliders, overlays and presets.

mods.name: A Quality World Map
mods.summary: Sharper, readable world map with roads; pick the variant that matches your other landscape mods.

mods.name: Static Mesh Improvement Mod (SMIM)
mods.summary: Rebuilt models for thousands of everyday objects; light on performance.
